adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Exercise-triggered bidirectional/polymorphic VT in a structurally normal heart with biallelic CASQ2 variants identifies CPVT from unstable SR calcium handling, spontaneous diastolic calcium release and delayed afterdepolarizations.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Brugada, long-QT and short-QT mechanisms alter membrane sodium/potassium currents rather than CASQ2-dependent SR calcium storage; an accessory AV pathway produces a different reentrant tachycardia.
